chapter_title: Foundations of CBI and Design Tensions
title: Portfolio Evidence Setup
description: CAT 531 textbook section connecting portfolio evidence setup to a portfolio evidence entry: an early-plus-later artifact growth trace with an annotated reasoning delta and a competency claim stated as a testable hypothesis, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Build a portfolio evidence entry that pairs an early and a later artifact, annotates the reasoning delta between them, and states the competency claim as a testable hypothesis
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to make a classroom technology decision more defensible

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
